summary: Request for a formal Gradle plugin to integrate the workflowcheck static analyzer into the Maven/Gradle build process, following the implementation in PR #2767.
userImpact: Developers would have better integration of workflow validation checks into their standard build processes.
proposedFix: Develop a formal Gradle plugin wrapper for the workflowcheck static analyzer
keyQuote: The `workflowcheck` static analyzer done in https://github.com/temporalio/sdk-java/pull/2767 should have a more formal Gradle plugin
